title: BBQ Profile
summary: Classic BBQ balance: sweet molasses/brown sugar, vinegar tang, smoke, and pepper heat.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — bbq profile is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: smoke, sweet, acid, spice. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Too sweet? More vinegar. Too sharp? Touch of fat or honey.
